---
# Contact fields are duplicated from content/cv_meta.yml here because the
# vitae::twentyseconds template reads its sidebar straight from this YAML
# header (not evaluated R) -- update both if contact info changes. The
# actual CV content below (education, positions, grants, publications) all
# comes from content/cv_*.csv via _common.R, same as the website's cv.qmd.
name: "William"
surname: "Pearman"
position: "Research Fellow"
address: "Auckland, New Zealand"
email: "william.pearman@auckland.ac.nz"
github: "wpearman1996"
linkedin: "william-pearman-6b3188392"
scholar: "Gn6BJkoAAAAJ"
profilepic: "profile.jpg"
aboutme: "Molecular and microbial ecologist working on population genomics and the evolution of host-microbe (holobiont) relationships."
date: "`r format(Sys.Date(), '%B %Y')`"
output: vitae::twentyseconds
header-includes:
  - \hypersetup{colorlinks=true, linkcolor=mainblue, urlcolor=mainblue}
---

```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = FALSE, warning = FALSE, message = FALSE)
library(vitae)
source("_common.R")
meta <- load_meta()
```

# Research Speciality

`r meta$speciality`

# Education

```{r}
education_tibble() |>
  detailed_entries(what = degree, when = year, with = institution, where = location)
```

# Positions

```{r}
positions_tibble() |>
  detailed_entries(what = title, when = dates, with = institution, where = location)
```

# Distinctions, Grants & Memberships

```{r}
#| results: asis
cat(render_cv_distinctions())
```

# Service & Outreach

```{r}
#| results: asis
cat(paste0("- Peer review: ", paste(meta$peer_review, collapse = ", ")))
```

# Publications

```{r}
#| results: asis
cat(render_cv_publications())
```
